old_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a long line of white dominoes arranged on a light-colored, marbled surface. A hand enters the frame from the left side, holding a black domino piece. The hand pushes the black domino, which causes the first white domino to fall, beginning the chain reaction. The hand moves away after the push. The dominoes continue to fall in a curved, serpentine sequence, creating a visually striking sequence. The video captures the dynamic motion of the dominoes as they collapse, emphasizing the precision and timing required for such an intricate setup. The hand is visible in the initial frames, and the background is static throughout.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a long line of white dominoes arranged on a light-colored, marbled surface. A hand enters the frame from the left side, holding a black domino piece. The hand carefully places the black domino at the end of the line of white dominoes. As soon as the black domino is positioned, it is pushed forward, initiating a chain reaction. The black domino falls first, causing the entire line of white dominoes to topple over in a cascading effect. The dominoes continue to fall in a wave-like pattern, creating a visually striking sequence. The video captures the dynamic motion of the dominoes as they collapse, emphasizing the precision and timing required for such an intricate setup. The background remains static throughout, focusing entirely on the dominoes and their movement.
caption: A long serpentine arrangement of upright white dominoes lies folded into parallel rows across a pale marble floor, with a single black domino resting on a stepped white base at the near-left end. An extended index finger presses the black domino, tilting it forward until it lies flat against the base. The first white dominoes on the stepped base tip in sequence, and the hand withdraws out of frame. A falling wave travels rightward along the bottom straight row, each tile toppling its neighbor. The collapse reaches the curved right end and reverses, propagating leftward along the middle row. As that row approaches the left curve, it tips the top row, which falls over from left to right. The not-yet-reached sections of the top row and the far-right tail remain upright, marking the boundary of the traveling collapse. The chain reaction is still underway when the clip ends.
